description: "More Mittens; with The Doll's Wedding and Other Stories" by Aunt Fanny is a collection of children’s stories written in the mid-19th century. This whimsical work features engaging tales that revolve around the imaginative adventures of young characters, including a playful girl named Alice and her doll, unfolding in a vibrant world filled with playful scenarios and charming events.
